name: All the Mods 10 (W3LFARe Auto-Updating)
author: admin@eraflew.com
description: All the Mods 10 (ATM10) Modded Minecraft Server powered by W3LFARe/docker-allthemods10. Supports automatic updates on reboot, persistent custom_mods and custom_config folders, and manual reinstall updates directly from the W3LFARe 6-hour auto-updated GitHub repository.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt update
apt install -y curl wget unzip jq

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.bin /mnt/server/custom_mods /mnt/server/custom_config
cd /mnt/server

cp -f /usr/bin/unzip /mnt/server/.bin/unzip 2>/dev/null || true
cp -f /usr/bin/jq /mnt/server/.bin/jq 2>/dev/null || true
chmod +x /mnt/server/.bin/* 2>/dev/null || true

echo "Fetching latest pack.env and launch.sh from W3LFARe/docker-allthemods10..."
if curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/W3LFARe/docker-allthemods10/main/pack.env -o pack.env.tmp && [ -s pack.env.tmp ]; then
    mv pack.env.tmp pack.env
    sed -i 's/\r$//' pack.env
else
    rm -f pack.env.tmp
fi

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/W3LFARe/docker-allthemods10/main/launch.sh -o launch.sh
sed -i 's/\r$//' launch.sh
sed -i 's|/data|/home/container|g' launch.sh
sed -i 's|/pack.env|/home/container/pack.env|g' launch.sh
chmod +x launch.sh

cat << 'EOF' > pelican-start.sh
#!/bin/bash
cd /home/container
export PATH="/home/container/.bin:$PATH"
export EULA="true"

# Ensure persistent custom_mods and custom_config directories exist
mkdir -p /home/container/custom_mods /home/container/custom_config

if [ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" == "1" ] || [ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" == "true" ]; then
    echo "[W3LFARe-Egg] AUTO_UPDATE is enabled! Checking W3LFARe/docker-allthemods10 for latest ATM10 release..."
    if curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/W3LFARe/docker-allthemods10/main/pack.env -o pack.env.tmp && [ -s pack.env.tmp ]; then
        mv pack.env.tmp pack.env
        sed -i 's/\r$//' pack.env
    else
        rm -f pack.env.tmp
    fi

    if curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/W3LFARe/docker-allthemods10/main/launch.sh -o launch.sh.tmp && [ -s launch.sh.tmp ]; then
        mv launch.sh.tmp launch.sh
        sed -i 's/\r$//' launch.sh
        sed -i 's|/data|/home/container|g' launch.sh
        sed -i 's|/pack.env|/home/container/pack.env|g' launch.sh
        chmod +x launch.sh
    else
        rm -f launch.sh.tmp
        echo "[W3LFARe-Egg] Warning: Could not reach GitHub, using existing launch.sh."
    fi
else
    echo "[W3LFARe-Egg] AUTO_UPDATE is disabled. Booting installed ATM10 version..."
fi

if [ -n "${SERVER_PORT}" ]; then
    echo "[W3LFARe-Egg] Enforcing Pelican Panel Port: ${SERVER_PORT}"
    sed -i "s/25565/${SERVER_PORT}/g" launch.sh

    if [ -f server.properties ]; then
        sed -i "s/^server-port=.*/server-port=${SERVER_PORT}/" server.properties
        sed -i "s/^query\.port=.*/query.port=${SERVER_PORT}/" server.properties
    fi
fi

# Fallback hook if upstream launch.sh does not yet contain custom_mods / custom_config / SERVER_PORT
if ! grep -q "custom_mods" launch.sh; then
    sed -i "s|./startserver.sh|if compgen -G \"/home/container/custom_mods/*.jar\" > /dev/null; then echo \"[W3LFARe-Egg] Copying persistent mods from /custom_mods to /mods...\"; mkdir -p /home/container/mods; cp -vf /home/container/custom_mods/*.jar /home/container/mods/; fi; if [ -n \"\\$(ls -A /home/container/custom_config 2>/dev/null)\" ]; then echo \"[W3LFARe-Egg] Copying persistent configs from /custom_config to /config...\"; mkdir -p /home/container/config; cp -rvf /home/container/custom_config/* /home/container/config/; fi; if [ -n \"\\${SERVER_PORT}\" ] \\&\\& [ -f server.properties ]; then sed -i \"s/^server-port=.*/server-port=\\${SERVER_PORT}/; s/^query\\\\.port=.*/query.port=\\${SERVER_PORT}/\" server.properties; fi; ./startserver.sh|g" launch.sh
fi

exec bash ./launch.sh
EOF

sed -i 's/\r$//' pelican-start.sh
chmod +x pelican-start.sh
echo "eula=true" > eula.txt
echo "Installation complete! Start the server to download and launch All the Mods 10."

variables.name: Auto Update on Reboot
variables.description: When enabled (1/true), the server fetches the latest launch.sh and pack.env from W3LFARe/docker-allthemods10 on every restart and upgrades ATM10 automatically if a new version was detected by the 6-hour GitHub Action.

variables.name: JVM Arguments
variables.description: JAVA Options. Performance Tip: Allocate at least 8-10 GB of RAM for 1-2 players, 10-12 GB for 2-5 players, or 14-16 GB for 5+ players.

variables.name: Server MOTD
variables.description: Message of the day displayed in the Minecraft server list.
variables.default_value: All the Mods 10 Server Powered by W3LFARe

variables.name: Allow Flight
variables.description: Whether players are allowed to fly in Survival mode (true or false).

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players allowed on the server at once.

variables.name: Online Mode
variables.description: Verify player accounts against Mojang authentication servers (true or false).

variables.name: Whitelist Users
variables.description: Add Users comma-separated to the Whitelist (e.g. TestUserName1, TestUserName2).

variables.name: OP Users
variables.description: Add Users comma-separated to grant Operator status (e.g. TestUserName1, TestUserName2).
